name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.4): notes only, no change in behaviour. A whole bank reconciliation statement can be ticked or unticked in ONE aspx_grid_batch call, one update per row: 23 rows were ticked and unticked in one call each on 2026R1, all verified, in about the time one row takes (KNOWLEDGE.md section 52). On build 24.111 one row per call is proven; the one batch tried there was refused because a person was saving the same statement. 'Another process has updated the CARecon record' means nothing was written and the call can be run again; such a refusal also says committed: true, so read possibly_saved and verification. 0.81.3 put the whole route for ticking rows on Reconciliation Statements (CA302000) in one place (section 51). Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
